//: metiche pointed at itself. Agents working ON metiche coordinate THROUGH metiche.
There is no credential in this file and there must never be one.
${METICHE_TOKEN} is expanded when this config is loaded; install.sh writes
it to ~/.metiche/env (mode 0600) as the anchor -- normally Claude Code's own
agent token -- and puts the line that loads it in your shell profile. It is
never a join code: a join code is an invite you redeem once, and the server
answers 401 if you send one as a credential.
This entry deliberately SHADOWS the user-scope 'metiche' server that
install.sh registers with `claude mcp add --scope user`, inside this
repository only, so that ${METICHE_MCP_URL} still redirects local
One header, Authorization. The token names the agent; nothing else is
needed, and Claude Code does not forward custom headers from here anyway.
